parsed.why: Worst division: enforceable criminal drag/impersonation ban, birth-sex facility law with indecent-exposure and trespass liability, prison and shelter placement by birth sex, panic defence, 7.8/100k trans-women killings with official indifference. State-imposed universal exposure above all else.

Among the most protective divisions: operating shield laws enforceable against out-of-state action, court-ordered prison care (one birth-sex disciplinary reversal), broad insurance coverage. Still capped by the restrictive national passport, entry and custody layer.

No bathroom restriction in force, cities protect restroom use, gender-identity hate-crime aggravator since 2019; a facility/prison bill died. Restrictive marker policies and minor care ban are resident-facing. Slightly above the national line.

School and college facility law by birth certificate with no enforcement mechanism or penalty, court-ordered marker narrowing, care ban in litigation, no state gender-identity statute but 33 local ordinances. Institutional exclusion, below parent.

Operative public-accommodations ban covering hotels and service providers, gender-identity hate-crime enhancement, panic defence repealed, gender-neutral single-user bathrooms, shield laws. Strongest traveller-facing protections, still under the hostile national regime.
